nodes.name: SrTiO3 substrate pretreatment
nodes.procedure: The SrTiO3 substrates were treated with NH4F-buffered hydrofluoric acid and annealed at 950°C in O2 for 1 hr to yield an atomic flat surface.
nodes.source_text: The SrTiO3 substrates were treated with NH4F-buffered hydrofluoric acid and annealed at 950°C in O2 for 1 hr to yield an atomic flat surface.

nodes.name: Substrate annealing
nodes.procedure: The MgO and TiO2 substrates were not subject to pretreatment but annealed at growth temperature for ~30 min.
nodes.source_text: The MgO and TiO2 substrates were not subject to pretreatment but annealed at growth temperature for ~30 min.

nodes.name: Pulsed laser deposition - (100) RuO2 on STO
nodes.procedure: Rutile films of (100) orientation were grown by pulsed-laser deposition (PLD) using a polycrystalline RuO2 target on pretreated (001)-oriented SrTiO3 substrates. PLD was performed with a KrF excimer laser (λ = 248 nm) to obtain films ~25 nm thick, which were deposited at the O2 pressure of 50 mTorr and cooled to room temperature under 200 Torr O2.
nodes.source_text: Rutile films of (100) and (110) orientation were grown by pulsed-laser deposition (PLD) on (001)-oriented SrTiO3... PLD was performed with a KrF excimer laser (λ = 248 nm) to obtain films ~25 nm thick, which were deposited at the O2 pressure of 50 mTorr and cooled to room temperature under 200 Torr O2.

nodes.name: Pulsed laser deposition - (110) RuO2 on MgO
nodes.procedure: Rutile films of (110) orientation were grown by pulsed-laser deposition (PLD) using a polycrystalline RuO2 target on MgO substrates under conditions similar to those in our previous work. PLD was performed with a KrF excimer laser (λ = 248 nm) to obtain films ~25 nm thick, which were deposited at the O2 pressure of 50 mTorr and cooled to room temperature under 200 Torr O2.
nodes.source_text: Rutile films of (100) and (110) orientation were grown by pulsed-laser deposition (PLD) on (001)-oriented SrTiO3 and MgO substrates... PLD was performed with a KrF excimer laser (λ = 248 nm) to obtain films ~25 nm thick, which were deposited at the O2 pressure of 50 mTorr and cooled to room temperature under 200 Torr O2.

nodes.name: Pulsed laser deposition - high-index RuO2 on TiO2
nodes.procedure: Films with (111), (101), and (001) orientations were grown by PLD using a polycrystalline RuO2 target on rutile TiO2 substrates of the same orientation. PLD was performed with a KrF excimer laser (λ = 248 nm) to obtain films ~25 nm thick, which were deposited at the O2 pressure of 50 mTorr and cooled to room temperature under 200 Torr O2.
nodes.source_text: Films with (111), (101), and (001) orientations were grown by PLD on rutile TiO2 substrates... nodes.name: RuO2 nanoparticle ink preparation
nodes.procedure: Nanoparticle catalyst ink was prepared with 4 mg acetylene black carbon, 20 mg RuO2 powder, 0.120 mL 3.33 wt% alkaline Nafion solution, and 3.88 mL tetrahydrofuran.
nodes.source_text: Nanoparticle catalyst ink was prepared with 4 mg acetylene black carbon, 20 mg RuO2 powder, 0.120 mL 3.33 wt% alkaline Nafion solution, and 3.88 mL tetrahydrofuran.

nodes.name: RuO2 nanoparticle electrode preparation
nodes.procedure: 10 μL ink (equivalent to 0.050 mg oxide) was drop cast on a glassy carbon electrode rotating disk electrode and slowly dried.
nodes.source_text: Then, 10 μL ink (equivalent to 0.050 mg oxide) was drop cast on a glassy carbon electrode rotating disk electrode (Pine Instrument) and slowly dried.
